annotations.title: Check AI visibility of a website

description: Free AI visibility and GEO (generative engine optimization) check for a company website by QQQ (qqq.ee). Checks whether AI crawlers (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended ...) may read the site, plus robots.txt, sitemap, Organization structured data, indexability and llms.txt, and returns the latest public report of brand mentions and citations in ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity answers when the domain has been checked before. The full AI answer check (brand visibility in live AI answers) runs on qqq.ee: the result always includes a prefilled link. Limited to a few checks per day; read-only.

domain.description: Public website domain or URL, for example example.com or https://www.example.com/. IP addresses and private hosts are refused.

language.description: Language of the answer and of the qqq.ee links: en (English, default) or et (Estonian).

name: check_ai_visibility
